summary: Uranium Royalty Corp. (URC) filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a private placement of subscription receipts to Uranium Energy Corp. (UEC) at US$3.64 per receipt for US$40 million gross. The receipts convert into URC common shares upon satisfaction of escrow conditions tied to URC's arrangement to combine with entities owning a 92% interest in Sweetwater Royalties from Orion and Ontario Teachers'. Post-conversion, UEC's stake would rise from ~12.27% to ~18.40%. UEC holds for investment and may adjust its position. The deal includes a return of funds if conditions are unmet. Watch for shareholder approval and arrangement closing, with risk-arb focusing on escrow release.
